title: Add production-shaped inspection intake endpoint
user_business_goal: Make the app consume real camera-pipeline metadata once camera/model/dataset artifacts arrive by adding a sanitized runtime inspection intake path that reuses existing SOP logic and audit persistence without granting production authority.
out_of_scope: live camera SDK loading or capture
model weights, TensorRT engines, ONNX/PyTorch runtime loading, training code, raw datasets, raw factory images, or notebooks
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, production auto-reject, production release/deploy
secrets, customer data, destructive migrations, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary changes
acceptance_criteria: Add a runtime inspection intake contract and builder for a single inspection payload with product code, size group, frame metadata, either provided measurements or boundary corners, and optional sanitized detector observations.
Add POST /inspection/intake that reads product specs and calibration only from env/default repo paths, never request-supplied paths.
The endpoint evaluates Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, and Phase 4 using existing app logic and returns an inspection.snapshot payload compatible with HMI/audit contracts.
If FLANGE_QC_V2_AUDIT_DB_PATH is configured, the endpoint initializes audit storage and persists the inspection idempotently.
The endpoint rejects request-supplied model_path, dataset_path, weights_path, artifact_intake_dir, product_specs_path, calibration_path, and manifest_path.
Boundary-corner payloads derive width/length/diagonal measurements through calibration; direct measurements still work.
Unknown products, missing/pending calibration, incomplete geometry, or invalid observations fail closed with explicit errors or BLOCKED decisions.
Response remains production_authority=false; model observations produce review-only ASSIST, not production PASS or NG.
Focused, product, and full repository checks pass.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 runtime inspection intake, camera-pipeline handoff, boundary/corners calibration, parallel QC evidence, audit persistence.
retrieved_decisions: Existing engine handles Phase 1/2 deterministic geometry and Phase 3/4 review-only fallbacks.
Production authority remains blocked until QC/product/model/hardware/release gates.
Raw media, model paths, dataset paths, and calibration/product-spec paths must not be request-supplied.
retrieved_lessons: Derive measurements from boundary plus calibration before SOP evaluation.
Keep Windmill outside the real-time PASS/NG runtime path.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: ASGI exposed only replay snapshot generation; runtime SOP logic existed but did not yet have a production-shaped sanitized intake endpoint.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-053 PR to remove the intake endpoint, contract/builder, tests, docs, and gate evidence. No production data, secrets, model artifacts, camera state, migrations, or release state is changed.
